prose.t: This is the platinum: it asks for nothing of its own, only the other 54 trophies, and it pops the moment the last one lands.
Two full guides put the whole run at about 200 hours, most of it on the 100% checklist; one guide warns it can pass 300 hours if you chase everything.
There are no online trophies and no difficulty setting, so one playthrough on any save is enough if you keep the missable moments in mind.

steps.t: Finish the story first, in chapters 1 to 5, and let the story trophies land as you go.
Work the stranger strands and side missions in phase 2, then activities and exploration in phase 3.
Clean up collectibles, money and grind trophies in phase 4, and watch the 100% checklist under Progress, Stats, 100% Completion.
When the last of the other 54 is earned, the platinum unlocks at once — no extra step.

tips.t: Keep a manual save at the start and end of each chapter — there is no mission replay, so a save is your only rewind.
Never enter a cheat during a trophy run: cheats switch off trophies and saving for that session.
